                (id, name, permissions, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES
                ($1, $2, $3, $4, $4)
            RETURNING
                id as "id!: Uuid",
                name,
                permissions,
                created_at as "created_at!: time::OffsetDateTime",
                updated_at as "updated_at!: time::OffsetDateTime"
